title: Zone Builder and Website Changelog fixes
content:
Zone Builder

  • Proc requests stay within their zone. Editing or deleting a request through another zone is rejected. Failed deletions retain the request and its mentions together, and a request deleted during an edit no longer sends an assignment or status notification.
  • Keep discussions together. Comments stay within their zone and discussion. Deleting a discussion either removes the full discussion and its mentions or keeps them all when the operation fails. New replies cannot attach to a parent that is being deleted.
  • Edit requests and comments again. Saving proc-request edits, changing status and editing comments now use the correct website requests. Builder API filters use the expected field names, and read-notification filters return the matching messages and totals.
  • Keep proc-request discussion history. Deleting a request keeps its comments and replies as general zone discussion, including their existing mentions. A failed deletion retains the original request and discussion together.

Website Changelog

  • Publish once and keep drafts private. Concurrent saves no longer trigger duplicate publication announcements or accidentally publish a competing draft. Announcements use the release title saved when publishing, so later unpublished draft titles stay private.
